body: Thanks for downloading {{guideTitle}}. You can open it any time with the button below.

guideFollowup.heading: Want us to map it for you?
body: A few days ago you downloaded {{guideTitle}}. If you're weighing up transport for your team, send us your headcount, sites and shift times.
We'll come back with a route plan and a fixed quote within 2 working days. No obligation.
